lead: Claude Duet goes proactive, Meta raises its capex ceiling again, and open tooling for running and coordinating agents has a busy day.

sections.title: Proactive agents move into products
sections.intro: Anthropic, GM and Meta all pushed agents that initiate rather than wait: Claude Duet opened a research preview as a background agent app, GM announced a voice-first OnStar assistant for the 2027 Lyriq, and Zuckerberg put early commerce numbers on Meta's Muse.

sections.title: Meta's AI bill keeps growing
sections.intro: Meta raised its 2026 capex outlook to as much as $145B and still beat on guidance, sending the stock up after hours.

sections.title: Open rails for running agents
sections.intro: Omnara launched an open-source, self-hostable alternative to the hosted agent APIs, while AuxoAI raised $20.7M to productize forward-deployed agent engineering for enterprises.

sections.title: Teaching agents to cooperate
sections.intro: A 2v2 Pokemon Showdown testbed measures how LLM teammates negotiate, correct each other and plan turns together.

sections.title: The grid under the build-out
sections.intro: A HARC report warns planned Texas data centers could erase decades of air-quality gains within five years if the load lands on gas.

sections.title: Odd drops
sections.intro: EYG embeds as a tightly controlled scripting layer inside Erlang applications.
